text:
Lab work complete — results from tools only:

Analyzed:
- E1 (0.39 m ±0.01 m): reliable, no problems. 602 frames, 16.3 cycles. Period 1.24798 s ±0.00051 s, zero-crossings 1.24765 s (agreement 0.48 sigma). Amplitude 11.1 deg. T0 1.24598 s ±0.00051 s. g from this alone 9.9175 ±0.2544.
- E2 (0.619 m ±0.003 m): reliable, warning: 2 outlier frames removed (>5 MAD). 585 frames, 12.3 cycles. Period 1.58836 s ±0.00075 s, zero-crossings 1.58858 s (agreement 0.23 sigma). Amplitude 11.5 deg. T0 1.58521 s ±0.00075 s. g from this alone 9.7247 ±0.048.

Damping (AIC):
- E1: viscous delta_aic 0.0 weight 0.862 preferred; coulomb delta_aic 3.76 weight 0.132 — weaker but still plausible, do not rule out per rule; quadratic delta_aic 9.74 weight 0.007; undamped delta_aic 900.78 weight 0.0.
- E2: quadratic delta_aic 0.0 weight 0.722 preferred; viscous delta_aic 2.1 weight 0.253 — equally supported / plausible per rule (delta <2-4); coulomb delta_aic 6.72 weight 0.025; undamped delta_aic 704.82 weight 0.0.
Verdict: model differs by experiment, runner-up within 4 in both cases. Say preferred, not proven. Damping is needed (undamped has no support) but law not decided.

g estimate (E1+E2, fit_length_offset false — only 2 distinct lengths):
g = 9.7314 ±0.0472, chi2 0.55 with dof 1, used [E1,E2], offset 0.0 ±0.0. This is now the current model.

Prediction:
- Pending P1 at 0.6 m cannot be tested by E2 at 0.619 m ±0.003 m — lengths differ, no experiment at 0.6 m yet. P1 remains unverified. No verify call made for mismatched lengths.
- New falsifiable prediction P2 registered for 0.30 m, amplitude 11.0 deg: T0 1.10319 s ±0.00613 s, period at amplitude 1.10574 s ±0.00614 s. Frozen; can only be confirmed by an experiment added later.
- Request sent to human for 0.30 m tape-measured experiment at ~11 deg.

LAB REPORT
Measured E1 and E2, both reliable; E2 had 2 outliers removed. Periods and T0 as above with uncertainties. Damping: viscous preferred in E1, quadratic preferred in E2, neither proven (runner-up delta 3.76 and 2.1). Combined g = 9.7314 ±0.0472 (chi2 0.55, dof 1). Prediction P2: 0.30 m pendulum should show 1.10574 s ±0.00614 s at 11.0 deg (T0 1.10319 s ±0.00613 s). P1 (0.6 m) untested. Next step: record the requested 0.30 m experiment, then verify P2.
